body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, move the target to another empty space adjacent to you and deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage.

surges.html: You may move 1 unit before relocating it.
On a hit, knock the target Prone if it ends beside an obstacle.

rider.title: Contingency - Reversal
rider.html: When an enemy attempts to pass through your vacated space, you may move 1 unit and give it -1 on its next Success Die before your next turn.
